variant_note: Independent community interpretation for request #283, using a rounded Chiikawa-inspired doodle style, a very long spotted tail and a small healed central nose mark. The mark's exact orientation is an artistic interpretation, not verified photo fidelity.
license: Non-commercial use only. Commercial use is prohibited. Independently generated, unofficial community interpretation; no ownership of the reference photograph or affiliation with its publisher is claimed.
description: A tiny rounded snow leopard with a pale rosetted coat, a very long curled spotted tail and a small healed nose mark, animated for nine Codex task states and sixteen clockwise head-led look directions.
asset_note: All final sprite pixels are independently generated through the built-in OpenAI image generation tool and assembled with deterministic Hatch Pet v2 scripts. Reference-photo pixels, scenery and text are not copied into or redistributed with the asset.
reference_note: The request's supplied image could not be inspected in this environment. Appearance is grounded instead in a separately dated 2025-08-16 government-hosted article about the same rescued snow leopard: https://www.forestry.gov.cn/c/www/lcdt/638346.jhtml and its recovery photo https://www.forestry.gov.cn/u/cms/www/202508/160728510yhd.jpg . The article displays Xinhua as its source and the image is credited to Xinhua distribution; the original photographer and redistribution permission are unverified. The requested healed nose mark is preserved as a consistent central line; exact original-photo placement and orientation are unverified.
